name: Assistente Jurídico | Tool - Transferir para humano

parameters.query:
-- Escolhe quem atende (área, urgência, quem já acompanha o cliente), registra e pausa a IA.
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS esc, $2::uuid AS lead, NULLIF(trim($3), '') AS motivo, NULLIF(trim($4), '') AS resumo,
         CASE WHEN lower($5) IN ('baixa','media','alta') THEN lower($5) ELSE 'media' END AS urgencia,
         NULLIF(lower(trim($6)), '') AS area),
r AS (SELECT * FROM responsaveis WHERE id = escolher_responsavel(
        (SELECT esc FROM p), (SELECT lead FROM p),
        COALESCE((SELECT area FROM p), (SELECT area FROM leads WHERE id = (SELECT lead FROM p))),
        (SELECT urgencia FROM p) = 'alta', false)),
enc AS (
  INSERT INTO encaminhamentos (escritorio_id, lead_id, responsavel_id, motivo, resumo, urgencia)
  SELECT p.esc, p.lead, (SELECT id FROM r), COALESCE(p.motivo, 'Solicitação de atendimento humano'), p.resumo, p.urgencia FROM p
  RETURNING id),
upd AS (
  UPDATE leads l SET status = 'humano',
         ia_pausada_ate = now() + make_interval(hours => e.horas_pausa_ia),
         responsavel_id = COALESCE((SELECT id FROM r WHERE faz_reunioes), l.responsavel_id),
         urgencia = (SELECT urgencia FROM p), atualizado_em = now()
  FROM escritorios e WHERE e.id = l.escritorio_id AND l.id = (SELECT lead FROM p) AND l.escritorio_id = (SELECT esc FROM p)
  RETURNING l.*)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM enc) AS encaminhamento_id, to_jsonb(r) AS responsavel, to_jsonb(upd) AS lead, to_jsonb(e) AS escritorio,
       p.motivo, p.resumo, p.urgencia, p.area,
       COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(x.linha, E'\n') FROM (
          SELECT CASE m.papel WHEN 'cliente' THEN '👤 ' ELSE '🤖 ' END || left(m.conteudo, 300) AS linha
          FROM mensagens m WHERE m.lead_id = p.lead AND m.papel IN ('cliente','assistente')
          ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT 6) x), '') AS ultimas_mensagens
FROM p JOIN upd ON true JOIN escritorios e ON e.id = p.esc LEFT JOIN r ON true;
UPDATE encaminhamentos SET notificado = $2::boolean WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id;
